panels.title: Простой самосвалов в очередях, % парка (за час)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "default")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.thingId == "org.openegiz.pit:dispatcher-01" and r._field == "value_idle_pct_dispatch_properties_value")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
